notes.title: Little Horror Raiser Trailer and Release Date!
notes.notes:
Little Horror Raiser releases on September 12th!

The trailer is up on Youtube and the store page.

[previewyoutube=RaTxVpdg2Yk;full][/previewyoutube]

In Little Horror Raiser you choose a little horror to raise, it's a very straightforward title. You can pick one of these:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42860201/563ecce76046971598a8e929a5bbd167d71e23bc.png[/img]

The Cosmic Horror, [b]Zu'Thun[/b]
The Zombie, [b]Rodiger[/b]
The Demon, [b]Sheevix[/b]
The Ghost, [b]Mistlight[/b]

These are the base names, you can rename them whatever.

When raising their stats it affects lots of things including the ending, there are over 20 endings with each horror having 5.

For example if you raise [b]Sheevix [/b]to be [b]Good [/b]and [b]Powerful[/b], the ending will be that she uses her strength to fight against other demons:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42860201/0f7f5bcbc0653fc6c09d333fda370b2527ef621d.jpg[/img]

These are the combinations:
[b]Good + Power
Good + Intellect
Evil + Power
Evil + Intellect
Neutral[/b]

(There are also some secret endings.)

Morality will also change how each horror looks while it grows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42860201/6ba91859a035108cfd9ac6575c5b60860bd18cfd.jpg[/img]
